parameters.note: The width of the image made for a share, in pixels (9:16 with story_height_px). The sticker is drawn at this width over the phone's pixel ratio, so the PNG comes out at it.
The height of a Story-sized image (a photo or dark background, K-975 part B); a sticker alone is as tall as its words.
The longest video that may sit behind a sticker in an Instagram Story: Instagram takes at most 20 seconds (Meta, Sharing to Stories, checked 7 Oct 2026, ADR-076 #5).
How many lifts the Progress sticker names: the ones that gained the most kilos since their baseline.
